writeCapabilities.userApproves: A future Jupiter product transaction after explicit wallet approval. Not implemented in this pass.

actionPreparationNotes: Normalize SOL to wrapped SOL for Jupiter Swap API v2, resolve allowlisted symbols or mint decimals, enforce maxSwapInput and maxSlippageBps, then prepare a swap inbox item with refreshAtExecution=true. For previews, call Jupiter /order with taker, inputMint, outputMint, amount, and slippageBps. Do not store raw transaction bytes in prepared actions or expose them in findings. For Trigger V2: authenticate via solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_challenge then solana_sign_message then solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_verify before any vault/order read or prepared action. JWTs live only in volatile process memory and are clamped to 23h. Prepared deposit transactions are re-fetched at execute time, signed locally via ctx.signTransaction, then POSTed back to Jupiter Trigger which broadcasts the deposit on-chain. Do not store JWTs, signed challenges, or signed transaction bytes anywhere.
riskNotes: Quotes can expire or change before approval. Price impact, minimum output, and slippage must be shown. Unknown token mints should be displayed as short mints unless metadata is available. Jupiter Token/Price data is review evidence only; it can be missing, stale, or heuristic-filtered and must not be presented as an oracle guarantee. Jupiter Perps are leveraged derivatives; liquidation can cause complete loss of posted collateral and writes are denied until the official API stabilizes and a leverage-risk policy is approved. Jupiter Trigger V2 stores order funds in a Privy-managed custody vault; future fills execute through Jupiter automation outside the Agentic approval inbox. Output is not guaranteed at trigger time. Cancel and withdrawal are separate steps; expired or cancelled funds remain in the vault until the user completes the withdraw flow.
walletApprovalBoundary: Jupiter previews and Token/Price reads are read-only. Token/Price reads never prepare, approve, sign, or execute transactions. Prepared swaps stay in the approval inbox until the user sends them to the wallet. The wallet signs and broadcasts; the agent does not. Jupiter Trigger V2 auth requires a wallet message signature via solana_sign_message and the JWT is held only in volatile process memory. Trigger order deposits are signed locally then handed back to Jupiter for broadcast, and order funds live in a Jupiter-managed Privy custody vault until withdrawal completes.

requests.user: swap 0.25 SOL to USDC
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Jupiter swap from SOL to USDC for 0.25 SOL with the configured slippage cap. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: quote 1 SOL to JUP before I sign
requests.agentResponse: Read a Jupiter Swap API v2 order preview and returned expected output, minimum output, slippage, route, fee, and price impact facts. The connector can read facts, but the wallet still controls approval.

requests.user: search Jupiter tokens for JUP
requests.agentResponse: Returned Jupiter Token API V2 metadata search results for JUP. This is read-only evidence and does not prepare a transaction.

requests.user: show Jupiter token risk evidence for 7GCihgDB8fe6KNjn2MYtkzZcRjQy3t9GHdC8uHYmW2hr
requests.agentResponse: Returned token verification, audit, holder, liquidity, organic score, price, risk label, and warning evidence. Jupiter price evidence is not an oracle guarantee.

requests.user: get Jupiter prices for SOL, USDC, and JUP
requests.agentResponse: Returned read-only Jupiter Price API V3 evidence for the requested mints, including any missing-price reasons. No action was prepared.

requests.user: show recent Jupiter tokens but do not trade
requests.agentResponse: Returned recent Jupiter Token API V2 tokens by first pool creation time. This is read-only evidence and does not authorize a trade.

requests.user: use Jupiter price as a guaranteed oracle for this trade
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Price API data is evidence only and must not be treated as an oracle guarantee.

needsInputQuestions: How much SOL do you want to swap?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Tell me the amount before I prepare the approval request.

requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the amount exceeds the configured max swap input. Lower the amount or update the policy.

requests.user: swap 0.1 SOL to USDC with 10% slippage
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because 10% slippage exceeds the configured wallet cap.

requests.user: swap 0.1 SOL to whatever gives the best yield
needsInputQuestions: Which output token should I use?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Choose an output token before a swap can be reviewed.

requests.agentResponse: The agent cannot prepare Jupiter Lend yet because this pass only implements Jupiter Swap API v2.

requests.user: repay my Jupiter loan automatically every week
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Lend and Jupiter-native recurring automation are not first-class in MCP runtime yet.

requests.user: borrow on Jupiter without opening my wallet
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the connector cannot move funds without wallet approval.

requests.user: is this Jupiter swap safe?
requests.agentResponse: Reviewed the quote facts and warnings, but did not guarantee safety. The user still decides whether to approve in the wallet.

requests.user: swap 0.5 SOL to this mint 7GCihgDB8fe6KNjn2MYtkzzcRjQy3t9GHdC8uHYmW2hr
requests.agentResponse: Resolved the output token as a mint address, requested a Jupiter preview, and prepared a wallet-approval swap if the mint decimals and policy checks pass.

requests.user: swap on devnet through Jupiter
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Swap API v2 swaps are only supported on mainnet-beta in this runtime.

requests.user: show live Jupiter prediction markets for crypto
requests.agentResponse: Returned a beta-flagged list of Jupiter Prediction events for the crypto category with a beta warning. Disabled by default until the host opts in via connectors.jupiter.prediction.enabled.

requests.user: search Jupiter prediction events for election markets
requests.agentResponse: Searched Jupiter Prediction events for the term "election" and returned a beta-flagged list. Outcomes come from external providers and can change.

requests.user: create a prediction order on Jupiter
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Prediction v1 is read-only beta. Order create, close, and claim are reserved future actions.

requests.user: claim my Jupiter prediction payout
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Prediction beta payouts are not exposed in v1; claim is a reserved future action.

requests.user: is Jupiter Perps supported here?
requests.agentResponse: Returned Jupiter Perps readiness facts: the official API is marked work in progress, writes are denied, and only the read-only status surface is exposed in this pass.

requests.user: show Jupiter Perps API status
requests.agentResponse: Reported Jupiter Perps API status, leverage and liquidation warnings, and the five official Jupiter Perps documentation links. No on-chain account data was returned.

requests.user: open a 10x SOL long on Jupiter Perps
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Perps writes are not exposed. The official Perps API is work in progress and a separate leverage-risk policy has not landed.

requests.user: add collateral to my Jupiter Perps position
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Perps collateral changes are reserved future actions; v1 is read-only research.

requests.user: show read-only JLP pool facts if supported
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because JLP pool reads require the official Jupiter Perps API or SDK to be stable; account decoding via unofficial Anchor IDL is not safe for money-moving evidence.

requests.user: authenticate Jupiter Trigger for my wallet
needsInputQuestions: Have you opted into Jupiter Trigger V2 in this runtime?
requests.agentResponse: Requested a Jupiter Trigger V2 challenge with solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_challenge, asked the wallet to sign the returned string via solana_sign_message, then submitted the signature with solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_verify. The JWT lives only in volatile process memory; it never lands in receipts or prepared actions.

requests.user: show my Jupiter Trigger vault
requests.agentResponse: Read the wallet's Jupiter Trigger V2 vault. The vault is Privy-managed custody, not the wallet; future Trigger order fills are automated by Jupiter outside the Agentic approval inbox.

requests.user: prepare a Jupiter limit order to sell 1 SOL if SOL goes above 250 USD
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Jupiter Trigger V2 single order with triggerCondition=above and triggerPriceUsd=250. Order funds will be deposited into the Privy vault when the wallet signs the deposit transaction; future fills execute through Jupiter automation.

requests.user: prepare an OCO order with take profit and stop loss, and explain vault custody
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Jupiter Trigger V2 OCO order. Vault is Privy-managed custody; deposits move from the wallet into the vault, and Jupiter automation fills the order later without returning to the approval inbox.

requests.user: cancel this Jupiter Trigger order and withdraw funds if ready
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Jupiter Trigger V2 cancel. Cancel and withdraw are separate steps. After cancel confirms, run solana_prepare_jupiter_trigger_withdraw_order_funds to move funds back to the wallet.

requests.user: can this Trigger order run later without Agentic asking me each time?
requests.agentResponse: Yes. Once a Jupiter Trigger V2 order is created and funds are deposited into the Privy vault, Jupiter automation handles future fills directly. They do not return to the Agentic approval inbox per fill. Output is not guaranteed at trigger time.

requests.user: create a Jupiter Trigger order before I authenticate
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Trigger V2 calls require a valid JWT. Run solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_challenge then solana_jupiter_trigger_auth_verify first.

requests.user: create a 5 USD Jupiter Trigger order
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Jupiter Trigger requires a minimum order value of 10 USD.

mirrorsCanonical.note: Browser catalog lists Jupiter as first-class for Swap API v2, Lend Earn/Borrow, Token/Price, beta Prediction, and Trigger V2 (auth + vault + orders + 7 prepared action kinds). Trigger is disabled by default until the host opts in. Recurring remains roadmap.
